review_candidates.title: Country Director - Ethiopia
review_candidates.description: Ethiopia Country Director - Ethiopia Organization GOAL Posted 13 Oct 2026 Closing date 30 Oct 2026 About Us GOAL has responded to the world’s major humanitarian crises since its founding in 1977, working with vulnerable communities in 13 countries across the globe with a dedicated team of personnel. While GOAL continues to be an agile first-responder to humanitarian crises, it is also committed to working with vulnerable communities to help them survive crises and support them on the road to recovery. About Our Programme GOAL has been operating in Ethiopia since the 1980s and today leads a diverse portfolio of humanitarian and development programmes delivered by approximately 500 staff. Our work reaches communities across 60 districts in eight regions and two city administrations, supporting people affected by conflict, displacement, climate-related shocks, and poverty. Working alongside government partners, local communities, UN agencies, and institutional donors, GOAL delivers programmes in Health & Nutrition, WASH, Food Security & Livelihoods, Protection, Safeguarding, and Emergency Response. Our work is supported by partners including Irish Aid, the European Union, UNHCR, UNICEF, OCHA, and others. Job Purpose We are seeking an experienced Country Director to lead GOAL's Ethiopia programme. Reporting to the Regional Director for Africa, you will provide strategic leadership across our programmes, operations, people, partnerships, and resources. As GOAL's most senior representative in Ethiopia, you will lead a large and diverse team, drive programme quality and growth, build strategic relationships with donors and stakeholders, and ensure the safe, effective, and accountable delivery of our work. This is a unique opportunity for an accomplished humanitarian leader to shape one of GOAL's largest country programmes and contribute to meaningful change for vulnerable communities across Ethiopia. Key Areas Of Responsibility Provide strategic leadership and direction for GOAL's Ethiopia programme, ensuring alignment with organisational priorities and country needs. Lead and support a high-performing Country Management Team and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation. Oversee the delivery of high-quality humanitarian and development programmes that achieve impact and meet donor commitments. Drive business development efforts by identifying funding opportunities and building strong donor and partner relationships. Represent GOAL with government authorities, donors, UN agencies, NGOs, and other key stakeholders. Ensure effective financial, operational, and risk management systems are in place to support programme delivery and growth. Maintain oversight of security, safeguarding, compliance, and duty of care across all country operations. Champion staff development, wellbeing, inclusion, and organisational culture. Skills & Qualifications We're looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record of managing complex humanitarian and development programmes. You Will Ideally Bring Significant senior leadership experience within an international NGO, humanitarian, or development organisation. Experience managing large-scale programmes and multi-disciplinary teams in complex or challenging environments. Demonstrated success in securing and managing institutional donor funding. Strong understanding of programme quality, operational management, compliance, and risk oversight. Excellent relationship-building, representation, and influencing skills. Experience working with government partners, institutional donors, and coordination bodies. A collaborative leadership style with a strong commitment to people management and team development. Commitment to safeguarding, accountability, and humanitarian principles. Why Join GOAL? This is a rare opportunity to lead one of GOAL's largest and most impactful country programmes. You will join a respected INGO with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality programmes and responding rapidly to emerging needs. The role offers the opportunity to influence strategy, strengthen partnerships, drive programme growth, and make a meaningful contribution to communities across Ethiopia. We strongly encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single requirement listed. At GOAL we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please just contact our Recruitment Team at recruitment.hq@goal.ie GOAL Commitment To Diversity, Equity And Inclusion GOAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We foster an inclusive culture where all voices are heard and valued, we are particularly eager to receive applications from women (and other underrepresented groups). We know that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling GOAL’s commitment to equal employment opportunity and equal treatment. GOAL does not discriminate against any employee or volunteer; or any applicant for employment or volunteering on the basis of age, gender identity, ancestry, political opinion, civil status, medical condition, ethnic background, disability, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. La vision de CEG est de fournir la meilleure expérience de collègue chaque jour pour alimenter la croissance, et ils s'engagent à s'assurer que toute l'équipe Amex a les ressources et le soutien dont elle a besoin pour être et fournir son meilleur. Dans ce rôle, le Chargé(e) de paie sera sous la responsabilité du Manager Payroll et fera partie de l'équipe Colleague Servicing Team (CS). Vous jouerez un rôle clé en fournissant une paie précise, conforme et en temps opportun sur plusieurs marchés de la zone EMEA, garantissant ainsi une expérience exceptionnelle pour vos collègues. Vous serez responsable de l'exécution des processus de paie de bout en bout, du partenariat avec les parties prenantes internes et les fournisseurs externes, et de l'amélioration continue des opérations de paie. Ce rôle exige une solide expertise en matière de paie, une attention aux détails et la capacité de fonctionner efficacement dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution. Responsibilities Vous êtes en charge de la réalisation de la paie dans son intégralité de l’entrée au solde de tout compte du salarié, des déclarations mensuelles, trimestrielles, des écritures comptables ainsi que de la DSN. Vous supervisez l’ensemble des activités liées à la paie: Vous gérez la relation avec le prestataire paie : Gestion et suivi des tickets Suivi de la conformité de la prestation Suivi et résolution des incidents Vous contrôlez la paie des salariés dans les délais impartis: Préparation et imports des éléments fixes et variables de la paie, Paramétrage des incidents de présence (congés payés, maladies, absences diverses, etc.), Préparation des bulletins d’expatriés et d’impatriés Vérification du bon déroulement mensuel des opérations de paie Etablissement des règlements Vous gérez les charges sociales et la relation avec les organismes sociaux: établissement des déclarations sociales mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles. Assurer l’ensemble des affiliations et radiations aux diverses caisses et déclarations de cotisations Vous répondez aux questions des salariés et assistez les managers en matière de paie, congés, charges sociales et droit social Vous contrôlez les soldes de tout compte Vous êtes le garant de la bonne application de la convention collective et du droit du travail en matière de paie et charges sociales Vous travaillez en collaboration étroite avec les autres services RH Activités transverses Etre force de proposition dans une démarche d’amélioration continue Assurer la veille réglementaire dans ces domaines Qualifications Diplômé(e) d’un bac +3, vous avez une expérience d’au moins 5 années sur un poste similaire. Doté d'une très bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques (pack office), vous avez également une connaissance du logiciel DECIDIUM. Votre anglais est courant et vous avez de bons réflexes en législation du travail et de la paie. Non-éligibilité à Une Prise En Charge De Visa Une autorisation de travail pour exercer chez American Express en France est requise, car l’entreprise ne financera pas de visa pour ces postes. La culture d’American Express repose sur 175 ans de tradition d’innovation, de valeurs et de comportements de leadership partagés, et un engagement inébranlable à soutenir nos clients, communautés et collègues. Nous opérons avec une forte conscience des risques, aussi bien dans notre proposition de produits différenciés que par notre service client d'envergure internationale, veillant à toujours respecter la promesse de notre marque en matière de confiance, de sécurité et de service. En tant que membre de l’équipe Amex, vous bénéficierez de ce puissant soutien avec une prise en charge complète de votre bien-être et de nombreuses opportunités d’acquérir de nouvelles compétences, de développer votre leadership et de faire évoluer votre carrière. This role serves as a key technical and commercial resource supporting customers, channel partners, and the outside sales team by delivering application expertise, accurate quotations, and value-added solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and business growth. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Qualify customer requests for quotation to ensure the proposed solution meets application and operational requirements. Prepare customer quotations that are technically accurate, commercially competitive, and submitted within agreed timelines. Convert MRO replacement inquiries into solution-selling opportunities by understanding customer challenges and proposing value-added solutions. Maintain CRM data integrity and support win/loss analysis activities. Work closely with factories and Business Development Managers to maximize local quotation capability and improve quotation accuracy. Prepare quotations using Oracle CPQ and maintain related opportunity records in CRM. Coordinate with Order Management teams to ensure smooth order handovers and complete supporting documentation. Participate in customer kick-off meetings when required. Achieve department KPIs, including quote response time, service levels, and hit ratio targets. Ensure compliance with Emerson trade compliance policies and business procedures. Support additional business requirements and projects as assigned. Who You Are You focus on understanding customer requirements and delivering effective technical solutions. You work collaboratively across teams to achieve business objectives. You communicate clearly and effectively with customers and stakeholders. You leverage your technical expertise to solve application challenges. You are action-oriented and committed to delivering results. For This Role, You Will Need Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 2-4 years of experience within the valve industry. Experience in technical quotations, application engineering, or inside sales activities. Strong understanding of valve and actuation products and applications. Familiarity with CRM systems and quotation management processes. Strong communication and customer engagement skills. Fluency in English and Arabic. Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart Experience with major valve OEMs in Application Engineering or Inside Sales roles. Experience supporting actuator and control accessory products. Experience working with customers across the Middle East and Africa region. Knowledge of Oracle CPQ and CRM systems. Strong commercial awareness and solution-selling capabilities. Our Culture & Commitment to You! At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our dedication to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family's physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide medical insurance plans, an Employee Assistance Program, tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work-life balance and offers flexible time-off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation, and holiday leave. Our training programs and initiatives focus on end-to-end development, from onboarding through senior leadership. We provide a wide range of development opportunities, including face-to-face and virtual training, mentorship, coaching, project management, and on-the-job training.

Si disfrutas entender cómo funciona una empresa, analizar problemas y ayudar a otras personas a resolverlos, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. Tendrás un plan de inducción y una persona del equipo que te acompañará en tus primeros meses. Empezarás en soporte y participarás progresivamente en pruebas, configuraciones y automatizaciones. ¿Qué harás? Atender consultas de usuarios y brindar soporte funcional y técnico de Nivel 1. Analizar incidencias, hacer verificaciones básicas y escalar los casos que requieran apoyo especializado. Documentar y dar seguimiento a las solicitudes. Colaborar en pruebas, configuraciones y capacitación de usuarios. Realizar consultas básicas en SQL. Apoyar en mejoras y automatizaciones del ERP. Usar herramientas de IA para investigación, documentación y soporte. ¿Qué valoramos? Curiosidad y capacidad de análisis. Organización y atención al detalle. Comunicación clara y paciencia para explicar soluciones a usuarios y clientes. Interés por aprender y compartir lo que sabes. Iniciativa para proponer mejoras. Valoramos que preguntes, compartas tus ideas y busques soluciones con el equipo. Formación Estudiantes de últimos ciclos o personas recién egresadas de Ingeniería de Sistemas, Software, Industrial o Empresarial; Sistemas de Información, Desarrollo de Software, Contabilidad, Administración o carreras afines con interés en tecnología. Conocimientos Base: SQL básico y fundamentos de programación. Suman: Python, programación orientada a objetos, nociones de ERP o CRM y conocimiento de procesos contables o administrativos. No necesitas experiencia laboral previa ni manejar todo lo que "suma". Si tienes la base y te interesa crecer en esta área, postula. Condiciones Lugar: Surquillo, Lima.
